name: QM (QP Modeler)
description: A model-driven design tool for hierarchical state machines in real-time embedded software, with C and C++ generation for the QP framework.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 由Quantum Leaps从2010年开始开发的模型驱动设计工具，主要用于实时嵌入式软件的状态机建模和代码生成。重点支持层次化状态机，并可结合QP实时事件框架自动生成C或C++代码。
